from tslearn.backend import numpy_backend

# X is a pre-loaded numpy array
res_true = numpy_backend.is_array(X)
res_false = numpy_backend.is_array([1, 2, 3])

assert res_true is True, "X should be recognized as an array by the numpy backend"
assert res_false is False, "A standard Python list should not be recognized as an array by the numpy backend"

print(f"__CHECK__ is_array {res_true}, {res_false}")
